name: The Fool
upright: New beginnings, innocence, spontaneity, a leap of faith
reversed_meaning: Recklessness, naivety, holding back, fear of the unknown
pkt_upright: Folly, mania, extravagance, intoxication, delirium, frenzy, bewrayment.
pkt_reversed: Negligence, absence, distribution, carelessness, apathy, nullity, vanity.

name: The Magician
upright: Willpower, manifestation, resourcefulness, skill
reversed_meaning: Manipulation, untapped talent, illusion, poor planning
pkt_upright: Skill, diplomacy, address, subtlety; sickness, pain, loss, disaster, snares of enemies; self-confidence, will; the Querent, if male.
pkt_reversed: Physician, Magus, mental disease, disgrace, disquiet.

name: The High Priestess
upright: Intuition, inner knowing, mystery, the subconscious
reversed_meaning: Secrets withheld, disconnection from intuition, surface noise
pkt_upright: Secrets, mystery, the future as yet unrevealed; the woman who interests the Querent, if male; the Querent herself, if female; silence, tenacity; mystery, wisdom, science.
pkt_reversed: Passion, moral or physical ardour, conceit, surface knowledge.

name: The Empress
upright: Nurturing, abundance, creativity, natural growth
reversed_meaning: Creative block, dependence, smothering, neglect of self
pkt_upright: Fruitfulness, action, initiative, length of days; the unknown, clandestine; also difficulty, doubt, ignorance.
pkt_reversed: Light, truth, the unravelling of involved matters, public rejoicings; according to another reading, vacillation.

name: The Emperor
upright: Structure, authority, stability, discipline
reversed_meaning: Rigidity, domination, absent leadership, chaos
pkt_upright: Stability, power, protection, realization; a great person; aid, reason, conviction; also authority and will.
pkt_reversed: Benevolence, compassion, credit; also confusion to enemies, obstruction, immaturity.

name: The Hierophant
upright: Tradition, guidance, shared beliefs, mentorship
reversed_meaning: Dogma, rebellion against convention, questioning institutions
pkt_upright: Marriage, alliance, captivity, servitude; by another account, mercy and goodness; inspiration; the man to whom the Querent has recourse.
pkt_reversed: Society, good understanding, concord, over-kindness, weakness.

name: The Lovers
upright: Love, alignment of values, meaningful choice, union
reversed_meaning: Disharmony, misaligned values, avoidance of choice
pkt_upright: Attraction, love, beauty, trials overcome.
pkt_reversed: Failure, foolish designs. Another account speaks of marriage frustrated and contrarieties of all kinds.

name: The Chariot
upright: Determination, victory through will, forward momentum
reversed_meaning: Lack of direction, scattered force, stalling, aggression
pkt_upright: Succour, providence; also war, triumph, presumption, vengeance, trouble.
pkt_reversed: Riot, quarrel, dispute, litigation, defeat.

name: Strength
upright: Quiet courage, compassion, patient strength
reversed_meaning: Self-doubt, raw emotion overpowering reason, burnout
pkt_upright: Power, energy, action, courage, magnanimity; also complete success and honours.
pkt_reversed: Despotism, abuse of power, weakness, discord, sometimes even disgrace.

name: The Hermit
upright: Introspection, solitude, inner guidance, searching
reversed_meaning: Isolation, withdrawal, loneliness, refusing counsel
pkt_upright: Prudence, circumspection; also and especially treason, dissimulation, roguery, corruption.
pkt_reversed: Concealment, disguise, policy, fear, unreasoned caution.

name: Wheel of Fortune
upright: Cycles, turning points, fortune, what goes around
reversed_meaning: Resistance to change, bad luck breaking, clinging to control
pkt_upright: Destiny, for tune, success, elevation, luck, felicity.
pkt_reversed: Increase, abundance, superfluity.

name: Justice
upright: Fairness, truth, cause and effect, accountability
reversed_meaning: Injustice, dishonesty, avoiding consequences, bias
pkt_upright: Equity, rightness, probity, executive; triumph of the deserving side in law.
pkt_reversed: Law in all its departments, legal complications, bigotry, bias, excessive severity.

name: The Hanged Man
upright: Surrender, new perspective, pause, letting go
reversed_meaning: Stalling, martyrdom, resistance, wasted sacrifice
pkt_upright: Wisdom, circumspection, discernment, trials, sacrifice, intuition, divination, prophecy.
pkt_reversed: Selfishness, the crowd, body politic.

name: Death
upright: Endings, transformation, necessary release
reversed_meaning: Fear of change, stagnation, decay held too long
pkt_upright: End, mortality, destruction, corruption; also, for a man, the loss of a benefactor; for a woman, many contrarieties; for a maid, failure of marriage projects.
pkt_reversed: Inertia, sleep, lethargy, petrifaction, somnambulism; hope destroyed.

name: Temperance
upright: Balance, moderation, patience, blending opposites
reversed_meaning: Excess, imbalance, impatience, discord
pkt_upright: Economy, moderation, frugality, management, accommodation.
pkt_reversed: Things connected with churches, religions, sects, the priesthood, sometimes even the priest who will marry the Querent; also disunion, unfortunate combinations, competing interests.

name: The Devil
upright: Attachment, temptation, shadow self, bondage chosen
reversed_meaning: Breaking free, reclaiming power, facing the shadow
pkt_upright: Ravage, violence, vehemence, extraordinary efforts, force, fatality; that which is predestined but is not for this reason evil.
pkt_reversed: Evil fatality, weakness, pettiness, blindness.

name: The Tower
upright: Sudden upheaval, revelation, collapse of the false
reversed_meaning: Disaster resisted, fear of ruin, slow-motion collapse
pkt_upright: Misery, distress, indigence, adversity, calamity, disgrace, deception, ruin. It is a card in particular of unforeseen catastrophe.
pkt_reversed: According to one account, the same in a lesser degree; also oppression, imprisonment, tyranny.

name: The Star
upright: Hope, renewal, healing, quiet faith after the storm
reversed_meaning: Despair, faith tested, disconnection from purpose
pkt_upright: Loss, theft, privation, abandonment; another reading says—hope and bright prospects,
pkt_reversed: Arrogance, haughtiness, impotence.

name: The Moon
upright: Intuition, dreams, uncertainty, the unseen path
reversed_meaning: Confusion lifting, fear released, secrets surfacing
pkt_upright: Hidden enemies, danger, calumny, darkness, terror, deception, occult forces, error.
pkt_reversed: Instability, inconstancy, silence, lesser degrees of deception and error.

name: The Sun
upright: Joy, vitality, success, warmth, clarity
reversed_meaning: Dimmed optimism, delayed success, forced cheer
pkt_upright: Material happiness, fortunate marriage, contentment.
pkt_reversed: The same in a lesser sense.

name: Judgement
upright: Awakening, reckoning, absolution, a higher calling
reversed_meaning: Self-judgment, ignoring the call, stuck in the past
pkt_upright: Change of position, renewal, outcome. Another account specifies total loss though lawsuit.
pkt_reversed: Weakness, pusillanimity, simplicity; also deliberation, decision, sentence.

name: The World
upright: Completion, integration, accomplishment, wholeness
reversed_meaning: Loose ends, incompletion, shortcuts, delayed closure
pkt_upright: Assured success, recompense, voyage, route, emigration, flight, change of place.
pkt_reversed: Inertia, fixity, stagnation, permanence. It will be seen that, except where there is an irresistible suggestion conveyed by the surface meaning, that which is extracted from the Trumps Major by the divinatory art is at once artificial and arbitrary, as it seems to me, in the highest degree. But of one order are the mysteries of light and of another are those of fantasy. The allocation of a fortune-telling aspect to these cards is the story of a prolonged impertinence.

name: Ace of Wands
upright: Inspiration, new venture, creative spark, potential
reversed_meaning: False starts, delays, scattered energy, hesitation
description: A hand issuing from a cloud grasps a stout wand or club.
pkt_upright: Creation, invention, enterprise, the powers which result in these; principle, beginning, source; birth, family, origin, and in a sense the virility which is behind them; the starting point of enterprises; according to another account, money, fortune, inheritance.
pkt_reversed: Fall, decadence, ruin, perdition, to perish; also a certain clouded joy.

name: Two of Wands
upright: Planning, future vision, progress taking shape
reversed_meaning: Fear of the unknown, playing safe, lack of planning
description: A tall man looks from a battlemented roof over sea and shore; he holds a globe in his right hand, while a staff in his left rests on the battlement; another is fixed in a ring. The Rose and Cross and Lily should be noticed on the left side.
pkt_upright: Between the alternative readings there is no marriage possible; on the one hand, riches, fortune, magnificence; on the other, physical suffering, disease, chagrin, sadness, mortification. The design gives one suggestion; here is a lord overlooking his dominion and alternately contemplating a globe; it looks like the malady, the mortification, the sadness of Alexander amidst the grandeur of this world's wealth.
pkt_reversed: Surprise, wonder, enchantment, emotion, trouble, fear.

name: Three of Wands
upright: Expansion, foresight, ships coming in, leadership
reversed_meaning: Obstacles to plans, delays, limited vision
description: A calm, stately personage, with his back turned, looking from a cliff's edge at ships passing over the sea. Three staves are planted in the ground, and he leans slightly on one of them.
pkt_upright: He symbolizes established strength, enterprise, effort, trade, commerce, discovery; those are his ships, bearing his merchandise, which are sailing over the sea. The card also signifies able co-operation in business, as if the successful merchant prince were looking from his side towards yours with a view to help you.
pkt_reversed: The end of troubles, suspension or cessation of adversity, toil and disappointment.

name: Four of Wands
upright: Celebration, homecoming, harmony, milestones
reversed_meaning: Instability at home, transience, canceled celebration
description: From the four great staves planted in the foreground there is a great garland suspended; two female figures uplift nose-gays; at their side is a bridge over a moat, leading to an old manorial house.
pkt_upright: They are for once almost on the surface—country life, haven of refuge, a species of domestic harvest-home, repose, concord, harmony, prosperity, peace, and the perfected work of these.
pkt_reversed: The meaning remains unaltered; it is prosperity, increase, felicity, beauty, embellishment.

name: Five of Wands
upright: Competition, friction, testing your position
reversed_meaning: Conflict avoided or festering, inner conflict, release of tension
description: A posse of youths, who are brandishing staves, as if in sport or strife. It is mimic warfare, and hereto correspond the
pkt_upright: Imitation, as, for example, sham fight, but also the strenuous competition and struggle of the search after riches and fortune. In this sense it connects with the battle of life. Hence some attributions say that it is a card of gold, gain, opulence.
pkt_reversed: Litigation, disputes, trickery, contradiction.

name: Six of Wands
upright: Victory, recognition, progress after struggle
reversed_meaning: Fall from favor, self-doubt, private defeat
description: A laurelled horseman bears one staff adorned with a laurel crown; footmen with staves are at his side.
pkt_upright: The card has been so designed that it can cover several significations; on the surface, it is a victor triumphing, but it is also great news, such as might be carried in state by the King's courier; it is expectation crowned with its own desire, the crown of hope, and so forth.
pkt_reversed: Apprehension, fear, as of a victorious enemy at the gate; treachery, disloyalty, as of gates being opened to the enemy; also indefinite delay.

name: Seven of Wands
upright: Standing your ground, perseverance, defense
reversed_meaning: Exhaustion, giving ground, feeling overwhelmed
description: A young man on a craggy eminence brandishing a staff; six other staves are raised towards him from below.
pkt_upright: It is a card of valour, for, on the surface, six are attacking one, who has, however, the vantage position. On the intellectual plane, it signifies discussion, wordy strife; in business—negotiations, war of trade, barter, competition. It is further a card of success, for the combatant is on the top and his enemies may be unable to reach him.
pkt_reversed: Perplexity, embarrassments, anxiety. It is also a caution against indecision.

name: Eight of Wands
upright: Swift movement, news arriving, momentum
reversed_meaning: Delays, frustration, resisting the pace of events
description: The card represents motion through the immovable—a flight of wands through an open country; but they draw to the term of their course. That which they signify is at hand; it may be even on the threshold.
pkt_upright: Activity in undertakings, the path of such activity, swiftness, as that of an express messenger; great haste, great hope, speed towards an end which promises assured felicity; generally, that which is on the move; also the arrows of love.
pkt_reversed: Arrows of jealousy, internal dispute, stingings of conscience, quarrels; and domestic disputes for persons who are married.

name: Nine of Wands
upright: Resilience, last stand, guarded persistence
reversed_meaning: Paranoia, worn down, refusing help, brittle defenses
description: The figure leans upon his staff and has an expectant look, as if awaiting an enemy. Behind are eight other staves—erect, in orderly disposition, like a palisade.
pkt_upright: The card signifies strength in opposition. If attacked, the person will meet an onslaught boldly; and his build shews that he may prove a formidable antagonist. With this main significance there are all its possible adjuncts—delay, suspension, adjournment.
pkt_reversed: Obstacles, adversity, calamity.

name: Ten of Wands
upright: Heavy load carried, responsibility, near completion
reversed_meaning: Burnout, carrying too much alone, put the burden down
description: A man oppressed by the weight of the ten staves which he is carrying.
pkt_upright: A card of many significances, and some of the readings cannot be harmonized. I set aside that which connects it with honour and good faith. The chief meaning is oppression simply, but it is also fortune, gain, any kind of success, and then it is the oppression of these things. It is also a card of false-seeming, disguise, perfidy. The place which the figure is approaching may suffer from the rods that he carries. Success is stultified if the Nine of Swords follows, and if it is a question of a lawsuit, there will be certain loss.
pkt_reversed: Contrarieties, difficulties, intrigues, and their analogies.

name: Page of Wands
upright: Enthusiastic messenger, exploration, free spirit
reversed_meaning: Bad news, immaturity, directionless enthusiasm
description: In a scene similar to the former, a young man stands in the act of proclamation. He is unknown but faithful, and his tidings are strange.
pkt_upright: Dark young man, faithful, a lover, an envoy, a postman. Beside a man, he will bear favourable testimony concerning him. A dangerous rival, if followed by the Page of Cups. Has the chief qualities of his suit. He may signify family intelligence.
pkt_reversed: Anecdotes, announcements, evil news. Also indecision and the instability which accompanies it.

name: Knight of Wands
upright: Action, adventure, charging ahead, passion
reversed_meaning: Impulsiveness, haste, frustrated momentum, recklessness
description: He is shewn as if upon a journey, armed with a short wand, and although mailed is not on a warlike errand. He is passing mounds or pyramids. The motion of the horse is a key to the character of its rider, and suggests the precipitate mood, or things connected therewith.
pkt_upright: Departure, absence, flight, emigration. A dark young man, friendly. Change of residence.
pkt_reversed: Rupture, division, interruption, discord.

name: Queen of Wands
upright: Confidence, warmth, magnetism, determined vision
reversed_meaning: Jealousy, demanding nature, insecurity behind bravado
description: The Wands throughout this suit are always in leaf, as it is a suit of life and animation. Emotionally and otherwise, the Queen's personality corresponds to that of the King, but is more magnetic.
pkt_upright: A dark woman, countrywoman, friendly, chaste, loving, honourable. If the card beside her signifies a man, she is well disposed towards him; if a woman, she is interested in the Querent. Also, love of money, or a certain success in business.
pkt_reversed: Good, economical, obliging, serviceable. Signifies also—but in certain positions and in the neighbourhood of other cards tending in such directions—opposition, jealousy, even deceit and infidelity.

name: King of Wands
upright: Bold leadership, vision, entrepreneurial fire
reversed_meaning: Impulsive rule, arrogance, ruthlessness, scattered vision
description: The physical and emotional nature to which this card is attributed is dark, ardent, lithe, animated, impassioned, noble. The King uplifts a flowering wand, and wears, like his three correspondences in the remaining suits, what is called a cap of maintenance beneath his crown. He connects with the symbol of the lion, which is emblazoned on the back of his throne.
pkt_upright: Dark man, friendly, countryman, generally married, honest and conscientious. The card always signifies honesty, and may mean news concerning an unexpected heritage to fall in before very long.
pkt_reversed: Good, but severe; austere, yet tolerant.

name: Ace of Cups
upright: New feelings, emotional beginnings, open heart
reversed_meaning: Blocked emotions, emptiness where joy should be, self-love needed
description: The waters are beneath, and thereon are water-lilies; the hand issues from the cloud, holding in its palm the cup, from which four streams are pouring; a dove, bearing in its bill a cross-marked Host, descends to place the Wafer in the Cup; the dew of water is falling on all sides. It is an intimation of that which may lie behind the Lesser Arcana
pkt_upright: House of the true heart, joy, content, abode, nourishment, abun­dance, fertility; Holy Table, felicity hereof.
pkt_reversed: House of the false heart, mutation, instability, revolution.

name: Two of Cups
upright: Partnership, mutual attraction, connection
reversed_meaning: Imbalance in a bond, tension, broken trust, self-reunion
description: A youth and maiden are pledging one another, and above their cups rises the Caduceus of Hermes, between the great wings of which there appears a lion's head. It is a variant of a sign which is found in a few old examples of this card. Some curious emblematical meanings are attached to it, but they do not concern us in this place.
pkt_upright: Love, passion, friendship, affinity, union, concord, sympathy, the interrelation of the sexes, and—as a suggestion apart from all offices of divination—that desire which is not in Nature, but by which Nature is sanctified.

name: Three of Cups
upright: Friendship, community, celebration together
reversed_meaning: Overindulgence, gossip, isolation from the group
description: Maidens in a garden-ground with cups uplifted, as if pledging one another.
pkt_upright: The conclusion of any matter in plenty, perfection and merriment; happy issue, victory, fulfilment, solace, healing.
pkt_reversed: Expedition, dispatch, achievement, end. It signifies also the side of excess in physical enjoyment, and the pleasures of the senses.

name: Four of Cups
upright: Apathy, contemplation, missed offer, reevaluation
reversed_meaning: New willingness, stirring motivation, accepting what's offered
description: A young man is seated under a tree and contemplates three cups set on the grass before him; an arm issuing from a cloud offers him another cup. His expression notwithstanding is one of discontent with his environment.
pkt_upright: Weariness, disgust, aversion, imaginary vexations, as if the wine of this world had caused satiety only; another wine, as if a fairy gift, is now offered the wastrel, but he sees no consolation therein. This is also a card of blended pleasure.
pkt_reversed: Novelty, presage, new instruction, new relations.

name: Five of Cups
upright: Loss, grief, focusing on what's gone
reversed_meaning: Acceptance, moving on, seeing what remains
description: A dark, cloaked figure, looking sideways at three prone cups; two others stand upright behind him; a bridge is in the background, leading to a small keep or holding.
pkt_upright: It is a card of loss, but something remains over; three have been taken, but two are left; it is a card of inheritance, patrimony, transmission, but not corresponding to expectations; with some interpreters it is a card of marriage, but not without bitterness or frustration.
pkt_reversed: News, alliances, affinity, consanguinity, ancestry, return, false projects.

name: Six of Cups
upright: Nostalgia, childhood, kindness, revisiting the past
reversed_meaning: Stuck in the past, rose-tinted memory, growing up
description: Children in an old garden, their cups filled with flowers.
pkt_upright: A card of the past and of memories, looking back, as—for example—on childhood; happiness, enjoyment, but coming rather from the past; things that have vanished. Another reading reverses this, giving new relations, new knowledge, new environment, and then the children are disporting in an unfamiliar precinct.
pkt_reversed: The future, renewal, that which will come to pass presently.

name: Seven of Cups
upright: Choices, fantasy, wishful thinking, options
reversed_meaning: Clarity of choice, illusions dissolving, commitment
description: Strange chalices of vision, but the images are more especially those of the fantastic spirit.
pkt_upright: Fairy favours, images of reflection, sentiment, imagination, things seen in the glass of contemplation; some attainment in these degrees, but nothing permanent or substantial is suggested.
pkt_reversed: Desire, will, determination, project.

name: Eight of Cups
upright: Walking away, seeking deeper meaning, departure
reversed_meaning: Fear of change, one more try, avoidance of the search
description: A man of dejected aspect is deserting the cups of his felicity, enterprise, under-taking or previous concern.
pkt_upright: The card speaks for itself on the surface, but other readings are entirely antithetical—giving joy, mildness, timidity, honour, modesty. In practice, it is usually found that the card shews the decline of a matter, or that a matter which has been thought to be important is really of slight consequence—either for good or evil.
pkt_reversed: Great joy, happiness, feasting.

name: Nine of Cups
upright: Contentment, emotional satisfaction, wish fulfilled
reversed_meaning: Smugness, dissatisfaction beneath comfort, hollow wish
description: A goodly personage has feasted to his heart's content, and abundant refreshment of wine is on the arched counter behind him, seeming to indicate that the future is also assured. The picture offers the material side only, but there are other aspects.
pkt_upright: Concord, contentment, physical bien-être; also victory, success, advantage; satisfaction for the Querent or person for whom the consultation is made.
pkt_reversed: Truth, loyalty, liberty; but the readings vary and include mistakes, imperfections, etc.

name: Ten of Cups
upright: Deep happiness, family harmony, lasting fulfillment
reversed_meaning: Broken harmony, misaligned values at home, strained bonds
description: Appearance of Cups in a rainbow; it is contemplated in wonder and ecstacy by a man and woman below, evidently husband and wife. His right arm is about her; his left is raised upward; she raises her right arm. The two children dancing near them have not observed the prodigy but are happy after their own manner. There is a home-scene beyond.
pkt_upright: Contentment, repose of the entire heart; the perfection of that state; also perfection of human love and friendship; if with several picture-cards, a person who is taking charge of the Querent's interests; also the town, village or country inhabited by the Querent.
pkt_reversed: Repose of the false heart, indignation, violence.

name: Page of Cups
upright: Creative dreamer, intuitive message, gentle curiosity
reversed_meaning: Emotional immaturity, escapism, blocked creativity
description: A fair, pleasing, somewhat effeminate page, of studious and intent aspect, contemplates a fish rising from a cup to look at him. It is the pictures of the mind taking form.
pkt_upright: Fair young man, one impelled to render service and with whom the Querent will be connected; a studious youth; news, message; application, reflection, meditation; also these things directed to business.
pkt_reversed: Taste, inclination, attachment, seduction, deception, artifice.

name: Knight of Cups
upright: Romance, idealism, following the heart, invitation
reversed_meaning: Moodiness, unrealistic promises, disappointment in love
description: Graceful, but not warlike; riding quietly, wearing a winged helmet, referring to those higher graces of the imagination which sometimes characterize this card. He too is a dreamer, but the images of the side of sense haunt him in his vision.
pkt_upright: Arrival, approach—sometimes that of a messenger; advances, proposition, demeanour, invitation, incitement.
pkt_reversed: Trickery, artifice, subtlety, swindling, duplicity, fraud.

name: Queen of Cups
upright: Compassion, emotional depth, calm nurturing presence
reversed_meaning: Emotional overwhelm, martyrdom, giving past empty
description: Beautiful, fair, dreamy—as one who sees visions in a cup. This is, however, only one of her aspects; she sees, but she also acts, and her activity feeds her dream.
pkt_upright: Good, fair woman; honest, devoted woman, who will do service to the Querent; loving intelligence, and hence the gift of vision; success, happiness, pleasure; also wisdom, virtue; a perfect spouse and a good mother.
pkt_reversed: The accounts vary; good woman; otherwise, distinguished woman but one not to be trusted; perverse woman; vice, dishonour, depravity.

name: King of Cups
upright: Emotional mastery, diplomacy, calm in the storm
reversed_meaning: Emotional manipulation, coldness, repressed feeling
description: He holds a short sceptre in his left hand and a great cup in his right; his throne is set upon the sea; on one side a ship is riding and on the other a dolphin is leaping. The implicit is that the Sign of the Cup naturally refers to water, which appears in all the court cards.
pkt_upright: Fair man, man of business, law, or divinity; responsible, disposed to oblige the Querent; also equity, art and science, including those who profess science, law and art; creative intelligence.
pkt_reversed: Dishonest, double-dealing man; roguery, exaction, injustice, vice, scandal, pillage, considerable loss.

name: Ace of Swords
upright: Breakthrough idea, clarity, truth cutting through
reversed_meaning: Confusion, misused intellect, clouded judgment
description: A hand issues from a cloud, grasping a sword, the point of which is encircled by a crown.
pkt_upright: Triumph, the excessive degree in everything, conquest, triumph of force. It is a card of great force, in love as well as in hatred. The crown may carry a much higher significance than comes usually within the sphere of fortune-telling.
pkt_reversed: The same, but the results are disastrous; another account says—conception, childbirth, augmentation, multiplicity.

name: Two of Swords
upright: Stalemate, difficult choice avoided, blocked feelings
reversed_meaning: Indecision breaking, information surfacing, choose
description: A hoodwinked female figure balances two swords upon her shoulders.
pkt_upright: Conformity and the equipoise which it suggests, courage, friendship, concord in a state of arms; another reading gives tenderness, affection, intimacy. The suggestion of harmony and other favourable readings must be considered in a qualified manner, as Swords generally are not symbolical of beneficent forces in human affairs.
pkt_reversed: Imposture, falsehood, duplicity, disloyalty.

name: Three of Swords
upright: Heartbreak, painful truth, grief that clarifies
reversed_meaning: Healing, forgiveness, releasing old pain
description: Three swords piercing a heart; cloud and rain behind.
pkt_upright: Removal, absence, delay, division, rupture, dispersion, and all that the design signifies naturally, being too simple and obvious to call for specific enumeration.
pkt_reversed: Mental alienation, error, loss, distraction, disorder, confusion.

name: Four of Swords
upright: Rest, recovery, retreat to restore the mind
reversed_meaning: Restlessness, burnout ignored, recovery resisted
description: The effigy of a knight in the attitude of prayer, at full length upon his tomb.
pkt_upright: Vigilance, retreat, solitude, hermit's repose, exile, tomb and coffin. It is these last that have suggested the design.
pkt_reversed: Wise administration, circumspection, economy, avarice, precaution, testament.

name: Five of Swords
upright: Hollow victory, conflict at any cost, discord
reversed_meaning: Reconciliation, releasing resentment, cost acknowledged
description: A disdainful man looks after two retreating and dejected figures. Their swords lie upon the ground. He carries two others on his left shoulder, and a third sword is in his right hand, point to earth. He is the master in possession of the field.
pkt_upright: Degradation, destruction, revocation, infamy, dishonour, loss, with the variants and analogues of these.
pkt_reversed: The same; burial and obsequies.

name: Six of Swords
upright: Transition, moving toward calmer waters, passage
reversed_meaning: Carrying baggage forward, resisting a necessary move
description: A ferryman carrying passengers in his punt to the further shore. The course is smooth, and seeing that the freight is light, it may be noted that the work is not beyond his strength.
pkt_upright: Journey by water, route, way, envoy, commissionary, expedient.
pkt_reversed: Declaration, confession, publicity; one account says that it is a proposal of love.

name: Seven of Swords
upright: Strategy, stealth, acting alone, calculated risk
reversed_meaning: Exposure, self-deceit, getting away with nothing
description: A man in the act of carrying away five swords rapidly; the two others of the card remain stuck in the ground. A camp is close at hand.
pkt_upright: Design, attempt, wish, hope, confidence; also quarrelling, a plan that may fail, annoyance. The design is uncertain in its import, because the significations are widely at variance with each other.
pkt_reversed: Good advice, counsel, instruction, slander, babbling.

name: Eight of Swords
upright: Feeling trapped, self-imposed restriction, victim mindset
reversed_meaning: Freeing yourself, perspective returning, options appear
description: A woman, bound and hoodwinked, with the swords of the card about her. Yet it is rather a card of temporary durance than of irretrievable bondage.
pkt_upright: Bad news, violent chagrin, crisis, censure, power in trammels, conflict, calumny; also sickness.
pkt_reversed: Disquiet, difficulty, opposition, accident, treachery; what is unforeseen; fatality.

name: Nine of Swords
upright: Anxiety, sleepless worry, fears magnified
reversed_meaning: Dawn after the dark night, worry released, seek help
description: One seated on her couch in lamentation, with the swords over her. She is as one who knows no sorrow which is like unto hers. It is a card of utter desolation.
pkt_upright: Death, failure, miscarriage, delay, deception, disappointment, despair.
pkt_reversed: Imprisonment, suspicion, doubt, reasonable fear, shame.

name: Ten of Swords
upright: Painful ending, rock bottom, betrayal, and dawn behind it
reversed_meaning: Recovery beginning, wounds closing, worst is past
description: A prostrate figure, pierced by all the swords belonging to the card.
pkt_upright: Whatsoever is intimated by the design; also pain, affliction, tears, sadness, desolation. It is not especially a card of violent death.
pkt_reversed: Advantage, profit, success, favour, but none of these are permanent; also power and authority.

name: Page of Swords
upright: Curious mind, new ideas, vigilance, restless energy
reversed_meaning: Gossip, scattered thinking, all talk and no plan
description: A lithe, active figure holds a sword upright in both hands, while in the act of swift walking. He is passing over rugged land, and about his way the clouds are collocated wildly. He is alert and lithe, looking this way and that, as if an expected enemy might appear at any moment.
pkt_upright: Authority, overseeing, secret service, vigilance, spying, examination, and the qualities thereto belonging.
pkt_reversed: More evil side of these qualities; what is unforeseen, unprepared state; sickness is also intimated.

name: Knight of Swords
upright: Swift decisive action, ambition, charging into the fray
reversed_meaning: Rushing headlong, burnout, aggression without aim
description: He is riding in full course, as if scattering his enemies. In the design he is really a prototypical hero of romantic chivalry. He might almost be Galahad, whose sword is swift and sure because he is clean of heart.
pkt_upright: Skill, bravery, capacity, defence, address, enmity, wrath, war, destruction, opposition, resistance, ruin. There is therefore a sense in which the card signifies death, but it carries this meaning only in its proximity to other cards of fatality.
pkt_reversed: Imprudence, incapacity, extravagance.

name: Queen of Swords
upright: Clear-eyed independence, sharp boundaries, honest counsel
reversed_meaning: Coldness, bitterness from old pain, harsh words
description: Her right hand raises the weapon vertically and the hilt rests on an arm of her royal chair; the left hand is extended, the arm raised; her countenance is severe but chastened; it suggests familiarity with sorrow. It does not represent mercy, and, her sword notwithstanding, she is scarcely a symbol of power.
pkt_upright: Widowhood, female sadness and embarrassment, absence, sterility, mourning, privation, separation.
pkt_reversed: Malice, bigotry, artifice, prudery, bale, deceit.

name: King of Swords
upright: Intellectual authority, truth, impartial judgment
reversed_meaning: Abuse of power, cold manipulation, tyranny of logic
description: He sits in judgment, holding the un­sheathed sign of his suit. He recalls, of course, the conventional Symbol of Justice in the Trumps Major, and he may represent this virtue, but he is rather the power of life and death, in virtue of his office.
pkt_upright: Whatsoever arises out of the idea of judgment and all its connexions—power, command, authority, militant intelligence, law, offices of the crown, and so forth.
pkt_reversed: Cruelty, perversity, barbarity, perfidy, evil intention.

name: Ace of Pentacles
upright: New opportunity, seed money, tangible beginnings
reversed_meaning: Missed chance, poor planning, scarcity thinking
description: A hand—issuing, as usual, from a cloud—holds up a pentacle.
pkt_upright: Perfect contentment, felicity, ecstasy; also speedy intelligence; gold.
pkt_reversed: The evil side of wealth, bad intelligence; also great riches. In any case it shews prosperity, comfortable material conditions, but whether these are of advantage to the possessor will depend on whether the card is reversed or not. Such are the intimations of the Lesser Arcana in respect of divinatory art, the veridic nature of which seems to depend on an alternative that it may be serviceable to express briefly. The records of the art are ex hypothesi the records of findings in the past based upon experience; as such, they are a guide to memory, and those who can master the elements may—still ex hypothesi —give interpretations on their basis. It is an official and automatic working. On the other hand, those who have gifts of intuition, of second sight, of clairvoyance—call it as we choose and may—will supplement the experience of the past by the findings of their own faculty, and will speak of that which they have seen in the pretexts of the oracles. It remains to give, also briefly, the divinatory significance allocated by the same art to the Trumps Major.

name: Two of Pentacles
upright: Juggling priorities, adaptability, balance in motion
reversed_meaning: Dropped balls, overcommitment, disorganization
description: A young man, in the act of dancing, has a pentacle in either hand, and they are joined by that endless cord which is like the number 8 reversed.
pkt_upright: On the one hand it is represented as a card of gaiety, recreation and its connexions, which is the subject of the design; but it is read also as news and messages in writing, as obstacles, agitation, trouble, embroilment.
pkt_reversed: Enforced gaiety, simulated enjoyment, literal sense, handwriting, composition, letters of exchange.

name: Three of Pentacles
upright: Craftsmanship, teamwork, skill being recognized
reversed_meaning: Mediocrity, working alone, misaligned team
description: A sculptor at his work in a monastery. Compare the design which illustrates the Eight of Pentacles. The apprentice or amateur therein has received his reward and is now at work in earnest.
pkt_upright: Métier, trade, skilled labour; usually, how-ever, regarded as a card of nobility, aristocracy, renown, glory.
pkt_reversed: Mediocrity, in work and otherwise, puerility, pettiness, weakness.

name: Four of Pentacles
upright: Security, saving, holding on, control
reversed_meaning: Greed, hoarding, letting go of control, generosity
description: A crowned figure, having a pentacle over his crown, clasps another with hands and arms; two pentacles are under his feet. He holds to that which he has.
pkt_upright: The surety of possessions, cleaving to that which one has, gift, legacy, inheritance.
pkt_reversed: Suspense, delay, opposition.

name: Five of Pentacles
upright: Hardship, feeling left in the cold, help nearby unseen
reversed_meaning: Recovery from loss, doors opening, accepting help
description: Two mendicants in a snow-storm pass a lighted casement.
pkt_upright: The card foretells material trouble above all, whether in the form illustrated—that is, destitution—or otherwise. For some cartomancists, it is a card of love and lovers—wife, husband, friend, mistress; also concordance, affinities. These alternatives cannot be harmonized.
pkt_reversed: Disorder, chaos, ruin, discord, profligacy.

name: Six of Pentacles
upright: Generosity, giving and receiving, shared resources
reversed_meaning: Strings attached, one-sided giving, debt
description: A person in the guise of a merchant weighs money in a pair of scales and distributes it to the needy and distressed. It is a testimony to his own success in life, as well as to his goodness of heart.
pkt_upright: Presents, gifts, gratification; another account says attention, vigilance; now is the accepted time, present prosperity, etc.
pkt_reversed: Desire, cupidity, envy, jealousy, illusion.

name: Seven of Pentacles
upright: Patience, assessment, long-term investment
reversed_meaning: Impatience with results, wasted effort, sunk costs
description: A young man, leaning on his staff, looks intently at seven pentacles attached to a clump of greenery on his right; one would say that these were his treasures and that his heart was there.
pkt_upright: These are exceedingly contradictory; in the main, it is a card of money, business, barter; but one reading gives altercation, quarrel—and another innocence, ingenuity, purgation.
pkt_reversed: Cause for anxiety regarding money which it may be proposed to lend.

name: Eight of Pentacles
upright: Diligence, mastery through repetition, dedication
reversed_meaning: Perfectionism, joyless toil, cutting corners
description: An artist in stone at his work, which he exhibits in the form of trophies.
pkt_upright: Work, employment, commission, craftsmanship, skill in craft and business, perhaps in the preparatory stage.
pkt_reversed: Voided ambition, vanity, cupidity, exaction, usury. It may also signify the possession of skill, in the sense of the ingenious mind turned to cunning and intrigue.

name: Nine of Pentacles
upright: Self-sufficiency, earned luxury, refined independence
reversed_meaning: Living beyond means, hollow success, self-worth from things
description: A woman, with a bird upon her wrist, stands amidst a great abundance of grapevines in the garden of a manorial house. It is a wide domain, suggesting plenty in all things. Possibly it is her own possession and testifies to material well-being.
pkt_upright: Prudence, safety, success, accomplishment, certitude, discernment.
pkt_reversed: Roguery, deception, voided project, bad faith.

name: Ten of Pentacles
upright: Legacy, family wealth, long-term security, culmination
reversed_meaning: Family disputes over resources, fragile foundations
description: A man and woman beneath an archway which gives entrance to a house and domain. They are accompanied by a child, who looks curiously at two dogs accosting an ancient personage seated in the foreground. The child's hand is on one of them.
pkt_upright: Gain, riches; family matters, archives, extraction, the abode of a family.
pkt_reversed: Chance, fatality, loss, robbery, games of hazard; sometimes gift, dowry, pension.

name: Page of Pentacles
upright: Studious beginner, manifestation in progress, ambition
reversed_meaning: Procrastination, distraction, dreams without groundwork
description: A youthful figure, looking intently at the pentacle which hovers over his raised hands. He moves slowly, insensible of that which is about him.
pkt_upright: Application, study, scholarship, reflection; another reading says news, messages and the bringer thereof; also rule, management.
pkt_reversed: Prodigality, dissipation, liberality. luxury; unfavourable news.

name: Knight of Pentacles
upright: Methodical progress, reliability, steady work
reversed_meaning: Stagnation, boredom, stubborn routine
description: He rides a slow, enduring, heavy horse, to which his own aspect corresponds. He exhibits his symbol, but does not look therein.
pkt_upright: Utility, serviceableness, interest, responsibility, rectitude—all on the normal and external plane.
pkt_reversed: inertia, idleness, repose of that kind, stagnation; also placidity, discouragement, carelessness.

name: Queen of Pentacles
upright: Practical nurturing, resourcefulness, grounded care
reversed_meaning: Self-neglect, smothering practicality, work-home imbalance
description: The face suggests that of a dark woman, whose qualities might be summed up in the idea of greatness of soul; she has also the serious cast of intelligence; she contemplates her symbol and may see worlds therein.
pkt_upright: Opulence, generosity, magnificence, security, liberty.
pkt_reversed: Evil, suspicion, suspense, fear, mistrust.

name: King of Pentacles
upright: Abundance, security achieved, steady leadership
reversed_meaning: Miserliness, status obsession, wealth without warmth
description: The figure calls for no special description; the face is rather dark, suggesting also courage, but somewhat lethargic in tendency. The bull's head should be noted as a recurrent symbol on the throne. The sign of this suit is represented throughout as engraved or blazoned with the pentagram, typifying the correspondence of the four elements in human nature and that by which they may be governed. In many old Tarot packs this suit stood for current coin, money, deniers. I have not invented the substitution of pentacles and I have no special cause to sustain in respect of the alternative. But the consensus of divinatory meanings is on the side of some change, because the cards do not happen to deal especially with questions of money.
pkt_upright: Valour, realizing intelligence, business and normal intellectual aptitude, sometimes mathematical gifts and attainments of this kind; success in these paths.
pkt_reversed: Vice, weakness, ugliness, perversity, corruption, peril.
